text.name: Mage's Robe
text.description:
{Mage's Robe}

Reduces cost of all spells by 1.
text.event: You came across a boy who was wearing a smart wizard’s hat and a robe that was too big for him. Lunging his twig in your direction, he shouted: "Ha! I hit you with my magic wand!" You laughed and began to play with him, pretending to be a knight and defending yourself with a wooden dagger. When it was time to leave, the boy exchanged this dagger with you for his hat and robe - now he wanted to be a knight. The hat was a useless thing, but the robe turned out to be a real magician's robe.
